Enum Class MoldSpecies

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<MoldSpecies>
moldsim.model.MoldSpecies
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<MoldSpecies>, Constable
public enum MoldSpecies extends Enum<MoldSpecies>
Represents mold species used in the simulation.

Each species defines environmental requirements and growth characteristics such as humidity tolerance, temperature range, infection probability, and growth speed.
